name: session-transcript-typing
description: Session transcript typing performance capture. Opens a session whose transcript contains a mermaid diagram, waits for the diagram to render, then types into the composer one character at a time. Each keystroke sets draft state on SessionDetailsPage, re-rendering the whole conversation pane — the path that used to remount every mermaid diagram and re-parse every message's markdown per keystroke.

metadata.label: Open a session whose transcript contains a mermaid diagram

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const deadline = Date.now() + 30000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const svg = document.querySelectorAll('[data-mermaid-host] svg').length; if (svg > 0) return { diagrams: svg }; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } return { diagrams: 0 }; })()

metadata.label: Wait until the mermaid diagram has rendered, so typing is measured against a settled transcript

evaluate.expression: (() => { const pane = document.querySelector('[data-testid="agent-session-messages"]'); if (!pane) return { error: 'transcript pane not found' }; const messages = pane.querySelectorAll('article').length; const chars = pane.textContent ? pane.textContent.length : 0; const diagrams = pane.querySelectorAll('[data-mermaid-host]').length; window.__diagramSwaps = 0; window.__skeletonAppearances = 0; const observer = new MutationObserver((records) => { for (const record of records) { record.removedNodes.forEach((node) => { if (node.nodeType === 1 && (node.nodeName.toLowerCase() === 'svg' || (node.querySelector && node.querySelector('svg')))) window.__diagramSwaps++; }); record.addedNodes.forEach((node) => { if (node.nodeType !== 1) return; const isSkeleton = (node.getAttribute && node.getAttribute('data-testid') === 'mermaid-skeleton') || (node.querySelector && node.querySelector('[data-testid="mermaid-skeleton"]')); if (isSkeleton) window.__skeletonAppearances++; }); } }); observer.observe(pane, { childList: true, subtree: true }); window.__diagramObserver = observer; performance.mark('bas.session-transcript-typing.ready'); return { messages, diagrams, chars, observing: 1 }; })()

metadata.label: Watch the STABLE transcript pane for SVG teardown — a remount destroys the diagram host itself, so an observer on the host is detached by the very event it should count

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const box = document.querySelector('[data-testid="agent-session-composer"]'); if (!box) return { typed: 0, error: 'composer not found' }; const setValue = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; const phrase = 'Summarize the diagram above and list the follow-up work it implies.'; box.focus(); let typed = 0; const startedAt = performance.now(); for (const ch of phrase) { setValue.call(box, box.value + ch); box.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); typed++; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 40)); } performance.mark('bas.session-transcript-typing.typed'); return { typed, elapsedMs: Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt) }; })()

metadata.label: Type character by character through the native setter — one draft state change, and therefore one page re-render, per keystroke

evaluate.expression: (async () => { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const result = { diagrams: document.querySelectorAll('[data-mermaid-host] svg').length, diagramSwaps: window.__diagramSwaps ?? -1, skeletonAppearances: window.__skeletonAppearances ?? -1, composerLength: (document.querySelector('[data-testid="agent-session-composer"]') || {}).value?.length ?? 0 }; performance.mark('bas.session-transcript-typing.settled'); window.localStorage.setItem('swarm-manager.perf.session-transcript-typing.result', JSON.stringify(result)); return result; })()

metadata.label: Report how many times a diagram was torn down and re-rendered during typing
